title: Drifter Desserts Lemon Tart 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lemon Tart by Drifter Desserts balances sharp, zesty Lemon with a buttery pastry base for a faithful recreation of a classic dessert. The citrus brings a bright, tangy edge, softened by smooth layers of sweet pastry and subtle creaminess that round out the profile. This Nic Salt e-liquid is mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, providing pronounced flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it works best with pod vapes, vape pens, and starter kits. With nicotine strengths of 5mg, 10mg and 20mg, it offers flexibility to suit different vaping preferences. Made in the UK by Juice Sauz, the Drifter Desserts line showcases dessert-inspired blends crafted with authentic flavour detail and quality ingredients. Elevate your vape refillable or starter vape kit with this easy-to-use liquid.
